overall_goal: Unload the dishwasher, reorganize the fridge, and check the cooking rice

goals.rationale: The person opens the fridge, moves a soup container and jars to create space, and closes the door.

goals.description: Unload chopping boards from the dishwasher
goals.rationale: The person takes chopping boards from the dishwasher, piles them, and stores them in a drawer.

goals.description: Unload bowls, pots, and pans from the dishwasher
goals.rationale: The person removes a bowl, pots, and a pan from the dishwasher, empties water from them, and places them in the lower cupboard.

goals.description: Unload plates, bowls, and mugs from the lower drawer of the dishwasher
goals.rationale: The person takes bowls, a glass, a mug, and plates from the lower drawer of the dishwasher and organizes them into the cupboards.

goals.description: Unload dishes, plates, and bowls from the middle drawer of the dishwasher
goals.rationale: The person opens the middle drawer, removes dishes, plates, and bowls, piles them on the countertop, and places the stack in the cupboard.

goals.description: Rearrange tupperware and unload some glasses and mugs
goals.rationale: The person removes a tupperware container from the cupboard to make space, then unloads a bowl, mugs, and glasses from the dishwasher into the cupboard.

goals.description: Unload remaining mugs, glasses, and a pot from the middle drawer
goals.rationale: The person finishes unloading mugs and glasses into the cupboard, then takes out a pot, empties its water into the sink, and places it on the drainer before closing the drawer.

goals.description: Unload spoons, spatulas, and chopsticks from the dishwasher
goals.rationale: The person opens the top cutlery drawer of the dishwasher and transfers spoons, wooden spoons, a spatula, and chopsticks into the kitchen drawer.

goals.description: Unload knives, forks, and remaining spoons from the dishwasher
goals.rationale: The person transfers knives, forks, and the rest of the spoons from the dishwasher to the cutlery drawer, then closes all open drawers and cupboards.

goals.description: Check and stir the cooking rice
goals.rationale: The person removes the lid from the pot on the hob, stirs the rice, checks its temperature, and covers it again.
The person puts on a right glove and adjusts their sleeve while holding the left glove.
